meta.evaluation_space: 1024 x 1024 aspect-preserving letterbox, black padding; RGB bilinear, labels nearest (run_inference.py load())
meta.leaf_rules: rust: abaxial face only; American leaf spot: mean of the two faces (IoU = mean of face IoUs; severity = mean of face severities)
meta.reference_grades: rust: from reference severity with cut-points 0.5/5/20 %; leaf spot: annotator's visual grade (G1-G3)
meta.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of leaves, percentile 95% CI, numpy default_rng(seed=20260927) re-seeded per disease; one index matrix per disease shared by all methods (paired differences); undefined resamples dropped and counted
meta.ccc: Lin's concordance correlation coefficient with 1/n moments
meta.loa: Bland-Altman limits: bias +/- 1.96 SD (SD with n-1) of predicted minus reference severity (percentage points)
meta.healthy_coverage: 21 healthy rust-pack TEST leaves are present locally (EARTH site); the paper used 54. The other 33 are not in the local pack. Healthy VALIDATION leaves: 21 (EARTH).

healthy_face_rules.either_face: PRIMARY (revision_brief.md item 10): flagged when either face meets the criterion; leaf value = maximum over the two faces
healthy_face_rules.leaf_rule: paper's diseased-leaf rule of the detector's disease (rust: abaxial face only; leaf spot: mean of the two faces)

healthy_flag_rules.any_pixel: any predicted lesion pixel (> 0 %; the paper's stated definition)
healthy_flag_rules.ge_0.5pct: predicted severity >= 0.5 % (predicted grade G1 or higher)
healthy_flag_rules.ge_5pct: predicted severity >= 5 % (false-positive rule used to select the rust CNNs)

meta.baseline_leaf_mask: reference leaf mask (letterbox label >= 1, i.e. alpha > 8), so the baseline's severity denominator is the exact reference leaf area; the networks segment the leaf themselves (their denominator is their predicted leaf)
meta.baseline_postprocessing: none (no smoothing, morphology or speck removal), matching the raw-argmax evaluation of the networks
meta.tie_handling: ri and exr global thresholds compared in exact integer arithmetic on the 8-bit letterboxed RGB (ri >= k/1000 <=> 1000(r-g) >= k(r+g+b); exr >= m/1000 <=> 200(7r-5g) >= m(r+g+b)); pixels exactly on the threshold count as lesion. a* compared in float64. Otsu thresholds are histogram bin centres compared in float64 (lesion = index > t).
meta.otsu_rule: per LEAF: one threshold from the pooled leaf pixels of the faces used by the evaluation (diseased leaves: rust abaxial, leaf spot both faces; healthy leaves, either-face rule: both faces). Per-face Otsu reported as a secondary variant.
meta.tuning_set: validation DISEASED leaves only (21 rust, 55 leaf spot); leaf IoU is undefined on healthy leaves, which are used only to report specificity
meta.selection: per disease, the configuration with the highest validation mean leaf IoU; evaluated once on test
meta.reference_rebuild_check: 388 images: rebuilt reference leaf and lesion pixel counts equal per_image.csv exactly

roya.note: pixels whose index equals the threshold exactly (leaf pixels of all validation and test images of the disease's pack); counted as lesion by the exact comparison

ojo.note: pixels whose index equals the threshold exactly (leaf pixels of all validation and test images of the disease's pack); counted as lesion by the exact comparison

secondary_specificity_constrained_leaf_r.rule: same, with the paper's leaf rule for healthy leaves (rust: abaxial face; leaf spot: mean of faces)
